The atlas comparison was decisive and correct: 5/10 nearest neighbors were Protein synthesis at high similarity in e6, consistent across all six doses from 0.01 to 30 uM, and the lowest dose in e9 already showed strong nuc_solidity and nuc_form_factor defects with reduced cell count.
